notablePrerequisites:
Sorcerer Class is at least level two.
You control at least six creatures without summoning sickness.
description:
Activate six creatures you control by tapping them, adding {4}{R}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells, or to gain a Class level.
Cast Fanning the Flames with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, triggering Jeskai Ascendancy's first and second abilities and Sorcerer Class's third ability if it is level three.
Resolve the Sorcerer Class trigger, if applicable, causing Fanning the Flames to deal an amount of damage to each opponent equal to the number of instants and sorceries you've cast this turn.
Resolve the first Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, giving creatures you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve the second Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, allowing you to loot.
Resolve Fanning the Flames, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Fanning the Flames to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control seven or more creatures without summoning sickness, this combo nets near-infinite mana.
